name: r7-cap4-qkcat
author: solx-loop
description: Fills the grid:capped4 niche. For B*S <= 2048 the grid is capped at 4 CTAs per SM (148*4 rounded down to a multiple of 3, i.e. 591 CTAs of 256 threads). Each half-warp walks the joined [Q;K] rows with stride grid*16, which is a multiple of 48, so its head is fixed. The next row's 256-bit loads are issued before the current row's reduction (ping-pong registers, no moves). Above 2048 tokens it runs the parent's one-shot kernel. This is a negative result: on the rented B200 the capped path is slowe
